# Headless test for SogReader + the loadScene() dispatch.
#
# Reads a REAL file: fixtures/synthetic.sog is PlayCanvas splat-transform's own
# output for the synthetic scene in ../common, regenerated by
# ../common/generate_fixtures.mjs. The test checks it decodes back to that
# scene, that the unbundled and DEFLATE forms decode identically, renders it
# against the source, and rejects corruptions of it.
add_executable(sabercat_sog_reader_test main.cpp)
add_dependencies(sabercat_sog_reader_test sabercat_shaders)

# zlib and nlohmann/json directly: the test unzips the fixture, re-zips it
# (STORED and DEFLATE) and edits its meta.json with its OWN code, so the
# variants it feeds SogReader do not come from the code under test.
target_link_libraries(sabercat_sog_reader_test PRIVATE
    sabercat ${_sabercat_zlib_build} nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)

target_compile_definitions(sabercat_sog_reader_test PRIVATE
    SABERCAT_SOG_FIXTURE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures"
    SHADER_DIR="${SABERCAT_SHADER_DIR}")
